description: A small daemon that writes the head unit's uptime and free memory to a status file once a minute. It exists as a worked example of a native package: one program, one config file and a pair of hook scripts that start and stop it.

notes: Settings: the status interval, what the status file says and where it goes can be changed from the phone
Status file now includes free memory
Config file is kept across upgrades
Trying a status line on the iDrive screen
